run_YTVISeval_evaluate: run YTVISeval.evaluate() to perform per video evaluation on ground truth and detection results
run_YTVISeval_accumulate: run YTVISeval.accumulate() to aggregate per video evaluation results into precision and recall arrays
run_YTVISeval_summarize: run YTVISeval.summarize() to compute and display summary metrics like AP and AR
create_YTVISeval_instance: create a YTVISeval instance with cocoGt and cocoDt objects to evaluate YouTubeVIS video instance segmentation
create_Params_instance: create a Params instance with iouType segm bbox or keypoints to configure evaluation thresholds
